id.description: The unique and required id of this instance.

endpoint.description: The endpoint of this external service instance

idleTimeoutMinutes.description:
Service instance is automatically cleaned up after this timeout, calculated
as elapsed time from last service "activity".
See ExternalServiceSession#sendKeepAlive and ExternalServiceSession#lastKeepAliveTimestamp
Note: a non-positive value indicates unlimited timeout

state.description: The status of the child process. This will be either RUNNING or STOPPED.

title:
This instance contains information on a single persistent session implemented by script code.
Persistent sessions are used to implement script-based {@link Engine.Deprecated engines}, which allows the code to build and
maintain a cache between calls.
NOTE: In general, an {@link ExternalService} should be accessible during provisioning. The facading here
allows consistent cache access during and outside-of provisioning.

@see Engine.Deprecated
name: ExternalServiceSession
